# package dynamics

`import "github.com/lestrrat-3d/decad/dynamics"`

[Module index](<README.md>)

<a name="pkg-overview"></a>
## Overview

Package dynamics advances rigid bodies using decad's certified geometry queries.
A world holds any number of bodies and their canonical pair table. Its step
drifts from event to event through the certified broad phase and solves the
contacts at each event time as certified Coulomb islands.

<a name="State"></a>
### type State

<pre>type State struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}</pre>

State is a value snapshot bound to its source [World](<#World>). Its entries slice is
never shared between two States that may diverge: code that derives a new
State by changing an entry starts from clone.

A State that a step published also carries that step's contact set and its reuse cache
(agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §3.2). Both are immutable and describe
exactly these entries; a State derived from it by clone drops them.

<a name="StepNoReason"></a><a name="StepPairUndecided"></a><a name="StepManifoldMissing"></a><a name="StepIslandDegenerate"></a><a name="StepIslandResidual"></a><a name="StepCorrectionFailed"></a><a name="StepTrackUnproved"></a><a name="StepKickUnbounded"></a><a name="StepConservationFailed"></a><a name="StepEventBudget"></a><a name="StepPairBudget"></a><a name="StepTravelUnbounded"></a><a name="StepFixedPairRelation"></a><a name="StepUnsupported"></a>

<pre>const (
    StepNoReason           <a href="#StepReason">StepReason</a> = iota
    StepPairUndecided                 // a candidate sweep is Undecided before the next event
    StepManifoldMissing               // an event pair has no manifold within StepConfig.Contact
    StepIslandDegenerate              // a closing constraint with no dynamic body, or K &lt;= 0, or a non-finite proposal
    StepIslandResidual                // a solver gate exceeds its limit at MaxIterations
    StepCorrectionFailed              // a position correction exceeds its allowance or loses a relation
    StepTrackUnproved                 // a contact-set pair has neither a persistent nor a band track
    StepKickUnbounded                 // the force kick cannot be bounded within the velocity residuals
    StepConservationFailed            // an island or step conservation gate fails
    StepEventBudget                   // MaxEvents reached with time remaining
    StepPairBudget                    // MaxPairSweeps reached
    StepTravelUnbounded               // SweptBox returned ErrUnsupported for a body
    StepFixedPairRelation             // a non-excluded Fixed/Fixed pair is Overlapping or Undecided
    StepUnsupported                   // the current phase has no solver for this event family
)</pre>

<a name="Timeline"></a>
### type Timeline

<pre>type Timeline struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}</pre>

Timeline chains the steps of one world from one start state
(agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §7.2). Its certified end is the
completed time of the last advanced step; it stops at the first Undecided
step and never advances past it.

Advance is the only writer: it must not run concurrently with Sample or
with another Advance. Sample writes nothing, so any number of Sample calls
may run concurrently between Advances, and each returns the same [State](<#State>) for
the same time.

<a name="NewTimeline"></a>
#### func NewTimeline

<pre>func NewTimeline(w *<a href="#World">World</a>, start <a href="#State">State</a>) (*<a href="#Timeline">Timeline</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

NewTimeline starts a timeline of w at start. w must not be nil, and start
must be a state of w.

<a name="Timeline.Advance"></a>
#### func (\*Timeline) Advance

<pre>func (tl *<a href="#Timeline">Timeline</a>) Advance(ctx context.<a href="https://pkg.go.dev/context#Context">Context</a>, input <a href="#StepInput">StepInput</a>, dt units.Value) (*<a href="#StepReport">StepReport</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

Advance runs [World](<#World>).Step for dt from the state the last advanced step
published, or from the start state. An Advanced report is appended; an
Undecided report stops the timeline and is returned with a nil error, since
an undecided step is a result, not a failure. A step error leaves the
timeline unchanged. After the timeline stops, Advance returns
ErrTimelineStopped.

<a name="Timeline.End"></a>
#### func (\*Timeline) End

<pre>func (tl *<a href="#Timeline">Timeline</a>) End() units.Value</pre>

End is the exact sum of the advanced durations, at the nearest float when
that sum is not one.

<a name="Timeline.Sample"></a>
#### func (\*Timeline) Sample

<pre>func (tl *<a href="#Timeline">Timeline</a>) Sample(t units.Value) (<a href="#State">State</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

Sample returns the certified state at t from the timeline's start. It
locates the step whose held interval holds t and delegates to that step's
[Trace](<#Trace>).Sample with the local time; a step boundary belongs to the later
step's start, which is the earlier step's end. t equal to End returns the
last advanced step's end state. A t below zero or beyond End is
ErrUnsupported.

The local time is t less the step's exact start. When that difference is
not a float, the nearest float inside the step labels it; the pose
returned is the certified pose at that label.

<a name="Trace"></a>
### type Trace

<pre>type Trace struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}</pre>

Trace keeps a step's record for replay: the event-free slices of §3.4 with
their rounded pair certificates, and the events between them
(agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §3.4).

<a name="Trace.Sample"></a>
#### func (Trace) Sample

<pre>func (tr <a href="#Trace">Trace</a>) Sample(t units.Value) (<a href="#State">State</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

Sample evaluates a recorded rounded path and its cached geometry proof.
It performs no response solve. It also reads the bodies' bounds through Document.SweptBox to check its swept-box
exclusions at the sampled poses (agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §7.1).
Sample writes nothing, so concurrent calls on one [Trace](<#Trace>) are safe.

<a name="World.Step"></a>
#### func (\*World) Step

<pre>func (w *<a href="#World">World</a>) Step(ctx context.<a href="https://pkg.go.dev/context#Context">Context</a>, from <a href="#State">State</a>, input <a href="#StepInput">StepInput</a>, dt units.Value) (*<a href="#StepReport">StepReport</a>, <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#error">error</a>)</pre>

Step drifts every body from event to event on
paths whose candidate pairs the broad phase selects and SweepPair certifies;
at each event time it solves the touching and impacting pairs as certified
Coulomb islands and continues (agent-docs/multibody-dynamics-design.md §5,
§6). Its Undecided report carries typed diagnostics and the certified prefix
in its [Trace](<#Trace>).
